findings.matchedLedgerStatus: H-01 fixed (story-014); M-01 fixed (minReward, race-to-win accepted); L-05 wont-fix (minReward==0 default); over-funding footgun owner-accepted
findings.reason: Count-gated winner-take-all nudge pot. BOUNDARY RE-CHECK PER PATTERN-MATCHER DIRECTIVE: the minReward floor present @321d0a9 is the SAME story-015 mechanism already in place at the run-13/run-16 acceptances — it only reverts a sniped LOSER from overpaying; it does not create a new drain, does not remove the owner-pin (story-014) that eliminates the permissionless free-claim, and does not bound/allocate the pot. It therefore did NOT shift the accepted H-01/M-01 boundary. Residual = (a) MEV race-to-cross-the-threshold among genuine mint-paying participants = M-01 accepted 'race-to-win is accepted protocol behavior'; (b) minReward==0 opt-out = L-05 wont-fix (contract cannot force a global floor; obligation lives at the front-end); (c) owner over-funding footgun (pot >= nudgeSize*mintPrice) = M-01 acceptance-invariant, owner-accepted operational. No new escalation. NOT re-reported as a new Medium. Suppressed to the accepted/wont-fix lineage; visible via this reconciliation entry for audit trail.
findings.law1Note: Parked visibly here rather than dropped. If a future run shows the yield funnel can push the nudge pot >= nudgeSize*mintPrice OR the minted NFTs gain a realizable/redemption path (RETRIAGE-001 / ECON-002 lineage), the pure-MEV drain premise returns and this must be re-opened above informational.

findings.reason: Immutable stakedId (L53/L107) carries no assertion it equals the staker's LIVE stakedId; a legitimate post-deploy setStakedId reconfiguration (NFT reissued under a new ID) silently (1) kills the permissionless claimTimedOut escape hatch (L242/L254 transfer the stale id) and (2) voids the parked-principal rescue floor (rescueERC1155 takes the else-branch at L283, sweeping full balance with no totalParked guard). Non-obvious deploy/reconfig footgun (Law 3, in scope). Bounded to Low (rescue is onlyOwner; no direct/permissionless theft). PROCEEDS to classification. RELATEDNESS FLAG (Law 1, keep-not-drop): shares the same contract and the same underlying 'immutable stakedId lacks live-parity assertion' root as the OPEN run-18 L-01 (which framed the DEPLOY-TIME mis-wire strand); this candidate develops the distinct DYNAMIC-DRIFT consequences (post-deploy setStakedId ⇒ killed timeout hatch + voided rescue floor). Flagged for finding-manager/severity-classifier to decide CONSOLIDATE-with-L-18-01 vs new sibling Low, rather than double-report.

NFTStakerMigrator stores an immutable stakedId NEVER referenced in migrate() and never asserted equal across old/new stakers; a stakedId mismatch is a hard DoS with clean atomic rollback (no fund loss). Dead immutable misleadingly implies a parity guarantee. No prior ledger entry for NFTStakerMigrator (run-18 covered InPlace migrator + Depletion). QA/hardening. Distinct contract and distinct failure mode from DEDUP-19-004 (clean DoS-revert here vs silent floor-void there). PROCEEDS to classification as QA.

findings.relatedLedgerLabel: M-01 (run-18, fp b58b172e..., FIXED @321d0a9 — cross-ref only, NOT a match)
findings.reason: story-020 removed the permissionless stake/unstake tail recomputes (closing the M-01 rate-drift), but depositFor RETAINS an unconditional tail _recomputeSchedule restarting windowEnd = now + windowSeconds on every call. CONFIRMED NOT A REGRESSION of M-01: depositFor is onlyMigrator (trusted, not permissionless), value-conserving, solvency-safe, and cannot be repeatably invoked by an attacker to grief the window — it is a faithfulness/operational residual with now-stale NatSpec ('for parity with stake'), not the reintroduced exploit. Fingerprint differs from M-01 (different function surface: depositFor vs _recomputeSchedule-via-stake/unstake). PROCEEDS to classification as a Low faithfulness residual (cross-ref M-01).

Post-story-020 the no-hook branch of _syncBudget settles accrual only (pure _updatePool, no recompute) but the NatSpec still claims 'behaves like a pure recompute' — stale docstring introduced BY the story-020 fix. Documentation-only, no functional impact (every config setter recomputes directly). No prior ledger entry. PROCEEDS to classification as QA doc-drift.

finalizeAndReset revives a drained Migrating pool to Active but does NOT recompute the schedule; post-story-020 stake() no longer auto-rearms, so a revive-then-organic-stake sequence (no depositFor re-seed) emits nothing until the owner calls setDepletionWindow/topUp. Value never lost; emissions pause until re-arm. This is a NEW consequence of the story-020 fix surfaced as an operational footgun (the InPlace path self-heals via depositFor's recompute, per DEDUP-19-006). No prior ledger entry. PROCEEDS to classification (severity-classifier to confirm Low vs QA).

Immutable priceScale unbounded/decimal-unchecked beyond ctor !=0; wrong magnitude swings emission rate/notional by orders of magnitude. Exact match to OPEN ledger L-08 (run-17). Not new, do NOT re-escalate above Low. Re-confirmed present @321d0a9. Not re-reported; carryover stub only. Bump lastSeenRun to phoenix-nft-staking-19.

unstake performs the outbound ERC1155 safeTransferFrom (onERC1155Received on a caller-chosen recipient) BEFORE the tail _recomputeSchedule, so during the callback totalStaked is decremented while rewardRate/windowEnd still reflect the old pool — value-reporting views (currentRewardRate/runwaySeconds/totalNFTValue) return a transiently inconsistent snapshot. State-changing reentry is blocked by contract-wide nonReentrant; impact requires an external oracle-style consumer of these views mid-callback (none known in scope). No prior ledger entry. Kept-not-dropped per Law 1 (victim is a hypothetical downstream integrator). PROCEEDS to classification as Low/informational (confirm no in-scope integrator prices collateral off these views).

DISPATCHER_INDEX hardcoded ASSUMED=4 and USDC hardcoded as nudge token; broadcast guards do NOT verify on-chain that the nudge token differs from the pinned dispatcher's primeToken() (only enforced at batchMint runtime). A wrong index pins the batcher to the wrong dispatcher/payment asset. Mitigated by documented manual-confirm + runtime revert. Non-obvious deploy-config operator footgun (Law 3). No prior ledger entry. PROCEEDS to classification as Low/QA operational hazard.

findings.matchedLedgerStatus: fixed (M-01) — restart-on-real-inflow explicitly retained as INTENDED per owner triage 2026-06-25
findings.reason: Every hook inflow>0 restarts the full depletion window; a third party can force a restart by minting an NFT then calling claim(), lowering existing stakers' instantaneous rate. Self-defeating griefing (each restart costs a REAL paid mint whose mintDebt is donated into the budget and paid to the very victims; accrual settled at OLD rate first; solvency-safe; emissions deferred not destroyed). RECONCILES to the owner-accepted M-01 design clarification: 'a non-zero pull inflow means a new NFT was minted = a genuine budget increase, so RESTARTING the depletion window on a real inflow is INTENDED and is being KEPT.' Suppressed as owner-accepted intended design; listed for ledger traceability. NOT a regression, NOT re-escalated.
